Floor Plans & Capacity Chart

The Centre offers dynamic meeting spaces adaptable for engaging standing conferences and meetings. Our Level 3 features a stunning foyer with floor-to-ceiling glass walls, offering breathtaking views of the award-winning 50-acre KLCC Park and the iconic Petronas Twin Towers. This space is perfect for standing events like receptions and networking sessions.

Contact us to craft your perfect standing conference, reception, or walking experience.
